lines.text: The church's gatherings do more harm than good, because each one eats without sharing while another gets drunk.
On the night He was betrayed, the Lord Jesus took bread, broke it and said, "This is My body."
After supper Jesus took the cup, called it the Passover of the Lord, and said to do this in remembrance.
Each one must examine himself before eating, because eating and drinking without recognizing the body brings judgment on himself.
When they come together to eat they should wait for one another, and anyone hungry should eat at the market.
